Definition
[Nonsingular solution (Definition 32.1)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0221 1. ch32:32.1\group Nonsingular Solutions

A solution $(\mathcal M^n,g(t))$ of the normalized Ricci flow on a closed manifold is nonsingular if it is defined for every $t\in [0,\infty )$ and there is a constant $C<\infty $ such that \[ |\Rm _{g(t)}|\le C \qquad \text{on }\mathcal M\times [0,\infty ). \]
